'''Kemm''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Quartermaster/Legends|supply officer]] serving the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]]. He was stationed on [[Voss]] in the [[Ken-La Outpost]] were he sold [[Stimulant/Legends|stimulants]].
